Volume 9, Chapter 4 — Calculating Widget Grants

Last Modified: 08/21/2026 • Published: 08/25/2023

This chapter explains how a school figures a Widget Grant. See Volume 3, Chapter 1 for calendars and Chapter 3 of this volume for payment periods.

Scheduled Widget Award

The scheduled award depends on:

  • the widget index;
  • the cost of widgets; and
    • a nested detail line
  • full-time enrollment.

Examples in this synthetic chapter use a fictional maximum ($9,999) and minimum ($999) widget award. Do not use them for packaging.

Calculated Widget Grant (Based on Index and Cost)

Follow these steps in order.

Step 1:

Subtract the index from the maximum.

Step 2:

Compare the result with the cost of widgets.

Volume 9, Chapter 4, Example 1: Low Index Owner

Pat has an index of 0 and a cost of $12,000. Pat receives the fictional maximum of $9,999.

After the steps, round the award to the nearest dollar.

Volume 9, Chapter 4, Example 2: Minimum Award

Sam's result is below $999, so no widget award is made.

A result under the minimum means no award.

Widget Formulas

Formula choice depends on the calendar. The annual figure of $1,234 is not fictional.
